about: Window makers' published formulas for a window's net clear opening (sash fully open), curated by hand from the maker's own PDF, each entry checked by a test against rows of the maker's own table (Gordium.Revit.Reading.Tests/MakerClearOpeningsTests.cs). Used only to pre-fill a window type's Gordium: Clear width, Clear height and Clear source as a draft the architect confirms (docs/revit/revit_interior_reading_design.md, section 3): never a confirmation, never a pass. All lengths are inches. An entry is added only when its formula was reproduced against a published row of the PDF actually opened (Andersen A-Series hung, 2026-11-20: its size guide prints the formulas and a symbol for sizes that meet egress, but no clear-opening row to reproduce, so it is not here).

match.how: the type's Manufacturer equals one of manufacturer AND (its shared Window Type parameter, read by GUID, equals one of window_type, OR its Model is a call number UCAwwhh). Every pre-fill needs the Model to be such a call number, and its width (ww) and height (hh) call numbers must be the standard table's for the type's frame Width and Height, else no pre-fill (a Window Type match alone is named in the list, never filled: a mulled unit can be a standard frame size overall); the type's Gordium: Operation, when set, must be this entry's operation: Marvin's mulled families (Window-Casement-Marvin-Ultimate-4W_1H, MultiW_1H, 1W_2H...) carry the same Window Type and a single unit's Model, so a Width that isn't that unit's frame is never filled. Window Type matches exactly ("Ultimate Casement - Tripane" doesn't).

cross_check.how: when the type has Marvin's shared Vent Area (an Area, read by GUID), the formula's clear width x height must agree with it within 0.02 sq ft, else no pre-fill (UCA3648: formula 28 7/8 x 42 in = 8.42 sq ft, Vent Area 8.43 SF). The family's Egress Window Yes/No is never read: a maker's flag is never a pass.

inputs.width: the type's Width is the frame outside measurement (Marvin's "Frame OSM" in the formula, the "Frame Size" column of Standard Unit Measurements: Casement): accepted only when it equals one of that column's widths
inputs.height: the type's Height is the frame outside measurement ("Frame Size" height column): accepted only when it equals one of that column's heights
inputs.why_standard_sizes_only: a family's Width may be the frame or the rough opening, and Gordium can't tell which from the number alone. Marvin's standard frame, rough-opening and masonry-opening sizes never coincide (rough = frame + 1 in wide, + 1/2 in high), so a Width and Height that are both a listed frame size can only be the frame. A rough opening, a masonry opening or a custom size gets no pre-fill.

valid.why: The width formula is Marvin's for a frame 20 in and wider (a narrower frame has another formula and a different hinge). Above 36 x 102, 40 x 92 or 44 x 71 1/8 in Marvin fits custodial sash limiters that limit travel, so the formula's full opening no longer holds: Gordium pre-fills only frames inside all three (at most 36 in wide and 71 1/8 in high), whichever way that sentence is read.

entries.caveats: the formulas are Marvin's "with Standard Screen"; a Window Opening Control Device limits the sash to under 4 in until released; custodial sash limiters on large frames limit travel; frames 20 to under 24 in wide take an 18 in wash/egress hinge and wider frames a 22 in one; the Tall Bottom Rail option isn't named in the formulas
entries.checked_rows_note: Marvin's table prints each clear width and height 1/64 in more than its own formula gives from the frame size (28 - 7 1/8 = 20 7/8 in, the table 20 57/64 in): the formula is the smaller, so the pre-fill is never larger than Marvin's table. The tests hold the formula to within 1/64 in of every row, and never above it, and the printed area (to 0.01 sq ft) between the formula's area and the printed width times height (CN 2060: 4.828 and 4.835, printed 4.83; CN 2864: 8.408 and 8.417, printed 8.42).
